Selected canonical Hugging Face GGUF references and estimated weight sizes from the pinned runtime dependency catalog, maintained as owned presentation data.
Reference layout of searchable options with size, fit, recommended and installed metadata, implemented with public Design Core Command View and Popover.

agentProviderConfiguration.reference: Buzz provider selection and no-prompt model discovery
agentProviderConfiguration.reason: Owned provider metadata and native catalog protocols; JJ Store shared compute uses existing trusted pairing. Presentation composes existing owned Settings rows and Design Core primitives.

adaptations.changes: Owned Svelte card grid, Form/YAML sequence and inspector, exact native revision dispatch and immutable run inspection. Compact Settings inspector, oval inset sequence blocks, hover/selected action controls and interactive connectors. Card summaries use recorded native trigger/first executor/remaining step count, with three layered action tiles, equal fixed-height cards, repository/name/date footer and a Settings description textarea.

workflowRunConsole.reference: Forgejo Actions step and log presentation
workflowRunConsole.usage: Reference inspection only; independently implemented owned Svelte presentation, no copied or vendored Forgejo source.
workflowRunConsole.adaptations: Recorded native actions/evidence, pinned on-demand reads, separate stdout/stderr assembly, nested group markers, current/historical attempts, public Design Core controls and contrast-compliant seconds/timestamps. ANSI conversion uses the MIT-licensed ansi_up 6.0.6 direct dependency.

workflowHostSettings.usage: Owned concise execution environment Settings, initially collapsed Advanced overrides and explicit admission, released Design Core CodeEditor/header tabs and existing avatar/agent Command View selectors. Repository context is resolved by the CLI through existing verified installation workspace links. No Community/Buzz runtime or code was copied.

githubWorkflowExecutor.reference: Application-owned workflow integration; Forgejo Runner local exec protocol inspection
githubWorkflowExecutor.usage: Owned Svelte path/Browse control reuses the existing Settings file input, with a pinned YAML Command chooser and native reporting projection. No Forgejo source is copied or vendored into production.

workflowHistory.reference: Maintained agent-session body layout and user-provided Forgejo Actions run-list screenshots
workflowHistory.usage: Owned Svelte implementation; reuses local Community-derived header, avatar, relative-time and resize components plus released Design Core primitives. Forgejo reference is visual inspection only; no copied or vendored Forgejo source.

forgejoReference.usage: User-provided run-list/menu screenshots; independent presentation adapted to native run identities and recorded source context.

workflowHistory.adaptations: Selectable source repositories and workflows, All workflows, flat runs, avatar-backed author filters, bookmark/status/manual-event filters, bounded paging, full-width pinned details and accessible mobile/resize controls.
